RESEARCH

Galactic foregrounds & CMB delensing

Finding a faint signal behind our Galaxy.

FOCUS & METHODS

CMB lensing / Component separation

View media gallery ↗

Scientific question

How do residual Galactic foregrounds affect reconstructed CMB lensing and the removal of lensing-induced B modes?

Why it matters

The search for primordial gravitational waves requires separating an extremely faint cosmological signal from brighter emission and lensing effects.

My contribution

Developing simulation and analysis workflows to study foreground residuals, lensing reconstruction, and their propagation into parameter inference.

Methods & tools

Python, CMB simulations, component separation, quadratic lensing estimators, and likelihood-based inference.

Results & evidence

Quantitative results and publication details will be added alongside the corresponding figures and verified references.

Transferable skills

Signal extraction, uncertainty propagation, reproducible simulations, and statistical validation.
